intro: Give your home a versatile touch with the Diwan bed. Use it as a day lounger, extra guest bed, or smart storage solution, while its walnut finish and sleek build keep your room stylish and clutter-free.

features.title: Three-in-one functionality
features.text: Works as a sofa, single bed, or lounger, making it a flexible piece of furniture for daily use and unexpected guests.

features.title: Hidden storage for clutter control
features.text: Lift the mattress panel to reveal easy-access storage, helping you keep bedding, cushions, or extras neatly tucked away.

features.title: Strong build for lasting use
features.text: Constructed with metal frames and 18 mm particle board, the bed ensures durability, sturdiness, and everyday reliability.

features.title: Walnut finish with timeless appeal
features.text: The Noce Versailles walnut shade adds warmth and blends with any décor, letting your diwan stand out wherever you place it.

features.title: Easy to move and assemble
features.text: Knockdown construction makes it simple to transport, shift, or reassemble whenever you redesign your living space.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
